title: Employee accounts
subtitle: Sub-accounts for the company's employees, with permissions set by a template
no_templates: No permission templates are available. Contact the developer to create one
empty: No employees with sign-in accounts yet
delete_body: Delete the account "{{name}}"? They will no longer be able to sign in.

templates.title: Permission templates
templates.delete_body: Delete the template "{{name}}"? A template assigned to an employee cannot be deleted.

modal.name: Employee name
modal.no_screens_hint: They see no screen until you choose a wider template for them. What they see never exceeds what your company sees.
modal.all_branches: All branches, including those added later
modal.hint_all: Sees all branches and general data, including any branch added later.
modal.hint_none: No branch: sees only general data (not assigned to a branch).
modal.hint_some: Sees only the selected branches and general data (not assigned to a branch); applies immediately without signing in again.
modal.master_data: Exempt from the master data lock
modal.master_data_hint: Allows them to edit properties and contracts even when these are locked for other employees.

template_modal.err_empty_screen: The screen “{{screen}}” has no permission. Grant it at least one action or remove it.
template_modal.name: Template name
template_modal.name_placeholder: Example: contract editor · front desk accountant
template_modal.hint: Choose the screens, then set what the employee can do on each one.
template_modal.salaries_hint: Salaries exists on the employees screen only: it shows and sets base salaries. Granting every action on that screen includes it.

reason.not_in_root: No longer in the permission template
reason.narrowed: Not held by the person above you

delegation.title: Delegate permissions to {{name}}
delegation.nothing: You hold no permissions that can be delegated. No one grants what they do not hold.
delegation.shown_hint: Only what you hold is shown. No one grants what they do not hold.
